notes:
- Cancel Perforce sync and revision downloads from the activity meter, and stop workspace scans even while a worker is starting.
- Choose one or more folders before scanning for Perforce Reconcile or Clean. Applying the selection rechecks only those files and respects changes made since the scan.
- Speed up Perforce browsing in large workspaces with virtualized file trees, paginated searches, and streamed sync summaries.
- Keep expanded folders with their Perforce connection so switching streams or reconnecting clears stale listings.
- Load Git history membership by page and bound diff previews for large changes.
- Serialize Git writes per repository and keep late refreshes or completed operations from updating a reopened tab.
